{{Quote|A prophecy from the Chamber of Ashes. It had been lost to us-|[[Keyo-So]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Chamber of Ashes''' was a canyon located on the eastern side of the [[Dark Heart]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. It originally held several [[Voss (species)|Voss]] prophecies, and [[Albathius]] landed his ship there and trained in the Chamber before falsifying a prophecy.
